3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:a032dcdc-b332.title: Speech Language Pathology Consultant  (New Jersey)
3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:a032dcdc-b332.description: What We're Looking For: We’re expanding our Speech Therapy services and need Speech-Language Pathologists (SLPs) to serve as part‑time consultants. You will help us shape local care models, expand insurance contracts, and if interested, create a launch‑pad to build or grow your own independent practice—without the usual operational headache. Key Responsibilities: - We are looking for a variable commitment, up to 1 hr commitment per week - Advise on state regulations, cultural nuances, and care‑model innovation. - Advise on policies and outcome metrics to ensure evidence‑based, family‑centered care. - Act as the primary credentialed provider for the group when we are applying to commercial and Medicaid plans in your state. - Use and critique our all‑in‑one tech stack (scheduling, data, EHR, billing) to guide product improvements. - If you wish, start seeing clients on our platform and build your own practice over time (no upfront fees, full ops support). What We Provide: - World‑class operational support so you stay focused on clinical input. - Fully integrated practice‑management suite, payer enrollment team, and rapid‑pay billing. - Access to a nationwide peer community - Priority eligibility for a full practice‑owner track with 3Y Health whenever you’re ready. Ideal Candidate: - Active SLP license in good standing in Texas - Familiarity with payer credentialing or utilization‑management processes is a plus. - Passion for expanding equitable speech therapy care and experimenting with outcome‑driven models. - Enjoys autonomy and remote, flexible collaboration Compensation Compensation will be $100-150 per hour dependent on experience and geographic location. About 3Y Health At 3Y Health, we believe SLPs deserve more — more freedom, more support, and more impact. That’s why we’ve created a platform where SLPs can launch and grow your own practice with no upfront costs and full operational support. We handle the logistics. You focus on care. For more information, please visit: https://3yhealth.com/specialties/speech-therapy What Makes 3Y Health Different? - $0 upfront to join — No fees, no hidden costs. - Earn up to $320,000/year based on your client caseload and schedule. - Concierge assistance with LLC creation, business banking, and liability insurance. - Total flexibility — You choose your hours, clients, and care model. - World-class support — We take care of operations so you can focus on clinical outcomes. - Custom referral support to help you build your preferred caseload. What We Provide Practice Owners: - All-in-one software suite – Includes Practice Management, Scheduling, EHR, Data Collection, Billing, Onboarding, and mobile apps for you and your clients. - Insurance partnerships – We’re adding new payer partnerships all the time in multiple states - Practice launch support – We’ll help you start your own SLP-focused company if you don’t already have one. - Fast payments – Get paid upfront per session. No more chasing down insurance. - Payroll made easy – We’ll run payroll for you if you’d like.

Since our founding in 2011, we've consistently pushed the industry forward and improved experiences for fans, making it easier than ever to discover events, find the perfect seats, and enjoy unforgettable live entertainment, and we continue to lead the evolution of our industry today. We're passionate about improving the fan experience and providing game-changing solutions for our clients, and we're always looking for smart, motivated people to help make it happen. Bring your enthusiasm, your big ideas, and your desire to team up with some of the best and brightest in technology and entertainment. Together we keep the world cheering. The Role AXS is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end strategy and execution of our Experience Control platform. This role is responsible for the mission-critical platform capabilities that power venue ingress and access control across the AXS ecosystem, including ticket and credential validation, scanner applications, access control integrations, developer-facing APIs and SDKs, operational telemetry, and the platform services that support millions of fans entering venues each year across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. You will work closely with Engineering, Access Control Partners, Client Services, Field Operations, and venue stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency, system reliability, and the fan experience across the live event lifecycle. jobgether-jobgether:lever:d4f537e2-6583-.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform
jobgether-jobgether:lever:d4f537e2-6583-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform based in Bulgaria. This is a greenfield SRE leadership opportunity within a large-scale, security-focused product environment. You will define what “healthy” means across roughly 70 components spanning cloud services and customer-hosted agents. You will establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring standards, alerting, and escalation practices from the ground up. Your work will directly improve the ability to detect silent security-control degradation before it becomes a widespread customer-impacting issue. You will collaborate closely with engineering leads and senior engineers while building the telemetry and reliability platform yourself. The environment is remote-first, async, technically demanding, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than dashboards for their own sake. This is an opportunity to shape the reliability culture and foundations of a major security product. Define and establish meaningful SLIs for approximately 70 product components, working with squad leads and senior engineers to agree on ownership, measurement, tiering, SLOs, and error budgets. Develop a reliability taxonomy covering service availability and latency, fleet reachability and configuration convergence, security-control efficacy, artifact delivery, and telemetry pipeline health. Ensure reliability indicators are independently measurable and cannot be disabled by the same failure they are intended to detect. Design and build the telemetry collection pipeline for customer-hosted agents and cloud services, balancing push-based collection, sampling, privacy constraints, data quality, and cardinality. Extend instrumentation across Python, Go, and Rust components in collaboration with product engineering teams. Consolidate existing dashboards, queries, and reporting mechanisms into a smaller, more reliable observability platform, retiring tooling that does not provide meaningful operational value. Implement symptom-based, SLO-driven alerting with multi-window burn-rate principles and clear page, ticket, and dashboard classifications. Ensure every production alert has a defined owner, documented failure mode, and actionable runbook. Establish ongoing alert-quality practices, including periodic reviews, measurable actionable-alert rates, and deliberate removal of unnecessary alerts. Build a machine-readable ownership and escalation model that routes incidents to the appropriate engineering squads. Establish severity definitions, acknowledgement expectations, follow-the-sun escalation practices, and clean handoff procedures across multiple time zones. Strengthen incident command and blameless postmortem practices, including reliable timelines, ownership, and follow-through on corrective actions. Coach engineering squads to own their own operational responsibilities and paging rather than becoming a centralized buffer for other teams' alerts. Deliver measurable reliability outcomes over the first year, including complete SLI ownership, production telemetry, tiered alerting, squad on-call adoption, and a significant reduction in the time required to detect silent security-control degradation. Requirements Substantial production engineering or SRE experience, including experience defining and implementing an SLO framework rather than simply operating within an existing one. Strong Python skills and the ability to read and modify Go or Rust code when implementing instrumentation and reliability improvements. Strong hands-on experience with time-series and event telemetry at scale, including Prometheus/OpenMetrics, Grafana, Alertmanager-class routing systems, and columnar or high-cardinality data stores such as ClickHouse or equivalent technologies. Experience debugging distributed systems running on bare metal and long-lived hosts; this role requires more than K

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e699770f-c611-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Operations & Service Growth based in United Kingdom. This is a high-impact leadership role combining business building, commercial growth, and hands-on operational management. You will turn an approved business vision into an executable roadmap while launching and scaling a technology-enabled service operation. The role combines strategic ownership with direct involvement in sales, service delivery, partnerships, and operational execution. You will oversee multi-location operations and work through Area and Location Managers to maintain consistent service quality and customer outcomes. A key focus will be improving digital conversion, retention, operational efficiency, and contribution margins. You will also build scalable systems that reduce manual work and create more predictable, repeatable operations. This opportunity is ideal for an entrepreneurial operator who enjoys building new businesses while simultaneously improving established operations. Translate an approved business vision into a clear, executable strategy, roadmap, operating model, and measurable priorities. Lead the launch and early development of a new technology-enabled service business, taking ownership of initial sales, service, and operating processes. Build and strengthen customer, merchant, delivery-partner, and other strategic networks required to support business growth. Provide hands-on, COO-level leadership across multi-location operations, working through Area and Location Managers to ensure consistent execution. Establish clear operational standards, performance expectations, and accountability mechanisms across locations and teams. Own service quality, speed, customer experience, and business outcomes across the operating network. Identify operational bottlenecks and implement practical solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and scalability. Drive improvements in online sales conversion, customer retention, digital performance, and contribution margin. Use AI, analytics, automation, and workflow tools to improve decision-making and reduce dependence on manual follow-up and individual intervention. Balance strategic growth initiatives with field-level execution, continuously identifying opportunities to improve both the business model and day-to-day operations. Develop managers and strengthen their ability to lead teams, meet performance expectations, and operate independently. Requirements Significant senior-level experience in operations, commercial leadership, business development, or a closely related field. Demonstrated track record of building, launching, scaling, or significantly improving a business, service operation, or distributed network. Strong experience in multi-location restaurant, delivery, logistics, hospitality, or service-based operations. Proven business development and partnership experience, with the ability to build relationships that generate commercial value. Strong understanding of operational performance, customer experience, service quality, and commercial growth. Hands-on experience using AI, analytics, automation, and workflow tools to improve business processes and decision-making. Strong leadership skills with experience managing managers, setting expectations, measuring performance, and developing team capability. Ability to operate comfortably across both high-level strategy and hands-on operational execution. Experience with online sales, e-commerce growth, digital conversion, or customer retention is a plus. Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate effectively in environments where processes are still being built and refined. Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to personally address operational challenges when necessary. Excellent communication, influencing, and decision-making abilities. Benefits HMO health insurance. Paid time off (PTO).

superiorexecutiveandlegalrecruiting-supe.description: Title: Managing Attorney, Referral Department Work Setup: Remote Are you an experienced attorney with a genuine interest in labor and employment law? If so, we want you to apply to join our cutting-edge labor and employment law firm dedicated to protecting workers' rights. We are currently seeking a highly motivated Managing Attorney to oversee the firm’s Referral Department. Our firm is looking for someone to help build out a robust referral business unit to generate referral fees for cases that the firm cannot take on itself. The Managing Attorney of the Referral Department will be responsible for evaluating a large and growing number of cases and recommending which cases should be referred out to one of the firm’s referral partners. The Managing Attorney will also be responsible for hiring and building out a new referral department team, training and coaching the team, and developing strategies for growth. This could be a great opportunity for an experienced employment litigator who no longer wishes to litigate cases. Must be a qualified California Bar member to be considered. Requirements: Active member of the California Bar 5+ years of labor and employment experience In-depth knowledge of wage and hour violations Proven track record of success in managing and leading teams We're looking for an attorney who is passionate about employment law and has a strong desire to positively impact our clients’ lives. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply today!
